alt: A bar chart showing a 30 FPS target for PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X and Xbox Series S. No 60 FPS or performance mode is announced.

data.title: One frame-rate target for every console
data.subtitle: Rockstar says GTA VI is targeting 30 frames per second on every console (Game Informer).
data.note: No 60 FPS or performance mode is announced. PS5 Pro gets a sharper picture and ray-traced shadows, not more frames.
